summary:
Prime Video is the streaming storefront at primevideo.com. It is not the Amazon shopping smile, so the files below are the ones this host returned rather than amazon.com’s favicon.

Checked 12 November 2026 against primevideo.com. HTML came from https://www.primevideo.com/offers/nonprimehomepage?ref_=dv_web_force_root (HTTP 503). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.primevideo.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 1150 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.primevideo.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 76×76 png.

Brand colour #0077ff comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-76x76-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-76x76-01.png at 76×76 (png, 1651 bytes) from https://www.primevideo.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
